run_process_single_cpp: run process to preprocess a single cpp file into a preprocessed hpp header for a given compiler mode
run_process_all_recursively: run process_all to recursively preprocess all cpp files in a directory tree into preprocessed headers
run_main_cli: run main to invoke the CLI and preprocess Boost MPL headers for one or all compiler modes
review_process_function: review the process function to understand how it invokes the preprocessor command and copies output headers
refactor_main_cli_args: refactor main to replace sys.argv parsing with a proper argparse CLI for mode and boost root arguments
